title: anathallis iota
intro: Anathallis iota, commonly known as the "Little Sun Orchid," is a species of orchid native to Brazil. It is an epiphytic orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. Anathallis iota has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic effects.
